adaptation.body: Mechanical extraction of AnimateBody through BoneGhost; Animator parameter type replaced by UpstreamAvatar; enable setters opened internally for Reset.
adaptation.clock: Managed Evaluate reproduces original Update frame-end guard, n+n1 and local pose Lerp; game clock owns loop/end lifecycle. Explicit game-only EvaluateLoopEndpoint evaluates FrameCount-1 then applies its saved next pose with the same original Lerp at rate 1 for whole-cycle root displacement. Reset restores captured post-construction TRS and original reader cursors/default enables.
adaptation.input: Explicit game-only UpstreamInputCompatibility removes data after the first NUL and normalizes established bone-name spellings before the strict reader bridge; no additional solver tracks are introduced. FromMotion builds original reader groups from shared already-converted raw-name keys, retaining key order and duplicate keys; original Raw IKFrames boundaries/order/display/entries are retained. Unknown/numeric bone names remain ignored.
adaptation.compatibility: Nullable native toe controllers; no MonoBehaviour/Animator/Avatar asset construction; fixed 0.08 metre unit.
adaptation.unsupported: Extra bone tracks are not added to the upstream standard mapping.
